objective: For every side n >= 3 that is not a power of two from 8, prove full reach for as large an infinite family of sides as can be reached (or state the obstruction), and carry the census one size past: every side from 3 to 130, exact at the powers of two 4 to 128. Predicted before the run: full reach at every side that is not a power of two from 8; at 128 exactly 124 contacts miss a ring, each the three rings of one corner, and 404 = 3n + 20 miss some contact.
title: Full reach at the other sides
